svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · RUNTIME WEIGHT HOT-RELOAD & RL WEIGHT SYNC (#385)
Zero-Copy CUDA IPC & Bucketed FP8 NCCL Broadcast vs. Disk Staging
In-Place GPU Pointer Copy Preserves Pre-Captured CUDA Graphs & Cuts 70B Weight Sync From 95.0s to 0.45s (98.5% Goodput)
• Actor writes 140 GB to Lustre/NFS (35s) + vLLM reads it back (38s)
• Re-allocating weight tensors invalidates CUDA Graph memory addresses
• Wastes another 22s re-capturing 32 batch sizes of CUDA Graphs!
• RL Step Goodput Collapses to 24.0% ($308,000/mo Wasted)
Tier 4: CUDA IPC (0.45s) & FP8 NCCL Broadcast (1.15s)
• Co-Located: Shares cudaIpcMemHandle_t pointers directly in HBM
• Disaggregated: Casts BF16->FP8 on-the-fly & broadcasts in 512MB buckets
• In-place param.data.copy_() preserves 100% of CUDA Graph pointers!
• 0.45s–1.15s Sync Latency (211x Faster) & 98.5% RL Step Goodput
4-Tier Runtime Weight Sync Matrix (70B Model · 128 GPUs · 30s RL Compute/Step)
Tier 1 (Disk .safetensors Reload) : Sync = 95.00s | Keep Graphs = No | Goodput = 24.0% | Waste = $308,000/mo
Tier 2 (TCP/gRPC Host Streaming) : Sync = 22.00s | Keep Graphs = Yes | Goodput = 57.7% | Waste = $171,000/mo
Tier 3 (400G RDMA BF16 Broadcast) : Sync = 2.40s | Keep Graphs = Yes | Goodput = 92.6% | Waste = $29,900/mo
Tier 4 (CUDA IPC / FP8 Broadcast) : Sync = 0.45s | Keep Graphs = Yes | Goodput = 98.5% | Waste = $6,050/mo
